_source: Cessna 1976 Skyhawk Model 172M Pilot's Operating Handbook (the owner's scanned copy, C172MPOH.pdf, sha256 a87f58e0f28c7ad0ffb0512249d10e44ee23199f01e6c3f2f9f1b1d698bb4446). Figures transcribed by hand from the page images on 2026-09-12: Section 2 page 2-6/2-7 (PDF pages 17-18) for weights and CG limits, Section 4 (PDF page 42) for the demonstrated crosswind, Section 6 figure 6-3 (PDF page 88) for station arms and figure 6-5 (PDF page 90) for the sample loading problem. This is the yardstick the model extraction is checked against.

sampleLoadingProblem._note: Figure 6-5, the POH's own worked example; the computation must reproduce its totals.

rows._note: The scan's OCR reads this as 12.8, but 340 lb at the 37 in front-seat arm is 12,580 lb-in, and only 12.6 makes the page's own printed total of 102.9 add up. Transcribed as 12.6.
